name: log_read
title: Read Logs
description: Reads a bounded snapshot of an allowlisted log source (HHC client, MCP server, or tunnel) on demand. Log content is not retained in central SQLite. Use log_follow_* when new log entries must be monitored continuously.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

source.description: Which log to read: HHC client, MCP server, or tunnel.

lines.description: Number of recent lines to return.

contains.description: Return only lines containing this text.

status.description: completed on success, failed on error.

tool.description: Echo of the invoked tool name.

client_id.description: Echo of the target host id.

source.description: Log source the result refers to.

truncated.description: True when output was cut to bounds.

error.description: Machine-readable error code when status is failed.

retryable.description: Whether a failed call may succeed on retry.
